mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM visit_invitation WHERE unique_code = #{uniqueCode} AND community_id = #{communityId} AND is_come = 0 AND status_cd = '0' LIMIT 1;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO business_visit_invitation(b_id, invitation_id, visit_type, visit_time, is_come, unique_code, user_id, qr_code, invitation_reason, community_id, operate) VALUES (#{bId}, #{invitationId}, #{visitType}, #{visitTime}, #{isCome}, #{uniqueCode}, #{userId}, #{qrCode}, #{invitationReason}, #{communityId}, #{operate})

INSERT INTO visit_invitation(invitation_id, visit_type, visit_time, is_come, unique_code, user_id, qr_code, invitation_reason, community_id, status_cd, b_id) SELECT invitation_id, visit_type, visit_time, is_come, unique_code, user_id, qr_code, invitation_reason, community_id, '0', b_id FROM business_visit_invitation WHERE b_id = #{bId} AND operate = #{operate}
